import narwhals as nw


def wide_to_long(df):
    nw_df = nw.from_native(df)
    long_df = nw_df.unpivot(
        on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
        index=["id"],
        variable_name="month",
        value_name="sales",
    )
    return nw.to_native(long_df)
